AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Harvesting and Storage? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water Harvesting and Storage.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Harvesting and Storage.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Harvesting and Storage.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Harvesting and Storage.

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Poultry Rearing in a Fold? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Poultry Rearing in a Fold.

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparation of Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preparation of Animal Products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparation of Animal Products.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparation of Animal Products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparation of Animal Products.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen and Backyard Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Pest and Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Pest and Disease Control.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving animal products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving animal products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving animal products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving animal products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving animal products.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
